title_en: Supreme People's Court Issues Notice Requiring Timely Handling According to Law of Criminals Who Evade Taxes, Resist Taxes, and Assault or Injure Tax Personnel
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court Issues Notice
Requiring Timely Handling of Criminal Offenders Involving Tax Evasion, Tax Resistance, and Assault or Injury of Tax Personnel According to Law

Recently, the Supreme People's Court issued a notice to the Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, requiring people's courts at all levels to severely punish, in accordance with the law, those criminal offenders who violate the criminal law by evading or resisting taxes, or by assaulting or injuring tax personnel.

The notice points out that recently, cases of tax evasion and tax resistance have increased in some localities, and incidents of assaulting or injuring tax officials have even occurred repeatedly. To ensure the smooth progress of the state's tax collection work and to protect the personal safety of tax personnel, the notice requires people's courts at all levels to handle in a timely and serious manner, in accordance with the law, those criminal offenders who violate the criminal law by evading or resisting taxes, or by assaulting or injuring tax personnel. In particular, for malignant cases that occur after the issuance of the Decision of the State Council on Strictly Enforcing Tax Work, the people's courts shall proactively cooperate with public security and procuratorial authorities, grasp the facts of the case, and resolutely impose severe punishment on the criminal offenders in accordance with the law.
